caps.en_desc: Curriculum Management designs, produces, or sources curriculum components.
caps.notes: Curriculum Management includes all those activities in the institution that plan and produce its portfolio of educational products, and ensures the institution is able to deliver them. It is also responsible for planning, deciding and providing the production inputs needed to deliver curricula. Institutions of higher education generally offer a broad portfolio of educational products that provide many different learning outcomes and which, accordingly, need different configurations of resources to deliver. As a result Curriculum Management is a complex capability and will incorporate a number of more specialised capabilities. "Curriculum" is defined as all the planned learning opportunities offered to learners by the educational institution and the experiences learners encounter when the curriculum is implemented.
caps.no_desc: Studieportefølje utformer, produserer eller anskaffer læreplankomponenter.

kids.en_desc: Curriculum Planning researches the need, demand, and opportunities for curriculum components and decides which will be developed.
kids.no_desc: Planlegging av studieportefølje undersøker behovet, etterspørselen og mulighetene for komponenter i studieporteføljen, og beslutter hvilke som skal utvikles.

kids.en_desc: Curriculum Design produces complete specifications of curriculum components.
kids.no_desc: Design av studieportefølje utarbeider fullstendige spesifikasjoner for komponentene i studieporteføljen.

kids.en_desc: Curriculum Production builds deliverable curriculum components that implement curriculum designs.
kids.no_desc: Produksjon av studieportefølje skaper leverbare komponenter som realiserer studieporteføljedesign.

kids.en_desc: Curriculum Accreditation is the assessment of an institution's curriculum against the standards set by accrediting authorities.
kids.notes: Curriculum Accreditation is a formal undertaking that occurs either at the system level (e.g., TEQSA in Australia) or at the specific-discipline level reflected by a subset of curriculum components (e.g., the accreditation of an institution's medical, dental, veterinary, or engineering academic programmes) and executive education.
kids.no_desc: Akkreditering av studieportefølje er vurderingen av en institusjons studieportefølje opp mot standardene fastsatt av akkrediterende myndigheter.

kids.en_desc: Curriculum Improvement adjusts the curriculum in response to past or predicted curriculum performance.
kids.notes: Curriculum Improvement incorporates practices and processes for curriculum quality management and for curriculum performance management.
kids.no_desc: Studie- og emneevaluering og revisjon justerer studieporteføljen basert på tidligere eller forventet ytelse av studie- og emnekomponentene.

kids.en_desc: Curriculum Disestablishment manages the discontinuation of curriculum components.
kids.notes: Curriculum Disestablishment may include the phasing out of curriculum components, such as programmes and units, while continuing to "teach out" and deliver certain offerings as required under grandparenting conditions to meet the needs of a final cohort of students.
kids.no_desc: Avvikling av studieprogram eller emner håndterer prosessen med å avslutte komponenter i studieporteføljen.

kids.en_desc: Offering Management determines which of an institution's curriculum components will be made available in each teaching session.
kids.no_desc: Utvikling av studieporteføljen bestemmer hvilke av institusjonens studieporteføljekomponenter som skal gjøres tilgjengelige i hver undervisningsperiode.

caps.en_desc: Student Management administers the student life cycle and maintains core student records.
caps.no_desc: Studentadministrasjon forvalter studenters livsløp og vedlikeholder kjernedata om studenter.

kids.en_desc: Scholarship Management administers the acquisition and management of non-repayable support awarded to students.
kids.notes: The scope of Scholarship Management is usually financial, administered as scholarships, bursaries, and awards. Scholarship Management provides an input to Financial Aid Management, where all financial dimensions of student study are administered and overseen.
kids.no_desc: Stipendforvaltning administrerer økonomisk støtte til studenter.

kids.en_desc: Placement Management establishes and assigns opportunities for students to participate in work-integrated and community-integrated learning activities and internships.
kids.notes: Placement Management includes finding placement opportunities (e.g., Work-Integrated Learning, Industry Affiliate Programmes, Community-Integrated Learning), matching students to these opportunities, managing the relationships and capturing the outcomes. The placement may or may not be to gain credits or payment but is always designed to contribute to learning outcomes. The placement may be (and usually is) undertaken in an external-to-the-institution context, but can also be structured equivalently with opportunities created within the institution. Internships may be required to meet the accreditation requirements of some professional societies, regulated practices, and licensed industries.
kids.no_desc: Praksisforvaltning etablerer og tildeler muligheter for studenter til å delta i arbeidsintegrerte og samfunnsintegrerte læringsaktiviteter og praksisplasser.

kids.en_desc: Student Academic Progress Management guides a student to completion of their studies.
kids.no_desc: Oppfølging av akademisk progresjon veileder studenten mot å fullføre sine studier.

kids.en_desc: Research Candidature Management defines and manages the conditions applicable to students undertaking postgraduate study by research.
kids.notes: Research Candidature Management enacts the framework usually associated with doctoral-level students, and encompasses the initial matchmaking with research topics and research supervisors, access to funding and resources, the specification and management of achievement towards agreed milestones, and the mechanics of the doctoral enrolment, such as whether doctoral students are studying as part- or full-time candidates, and the expectations around the duration of the study. This works in with [Student Research Assessment] and [Student Supervision], in addition to aspects of [Workforce Training & Development].
kids.no_desc: Doktorgradsadministrasjon definerer og administrerer vilkår for studenter som gjennomfører forskningsbaserte studier på masternivå eller høyere.

kids.en_desc: Student Misconduct Management investigates and determines consequences for instances of student behaviour that breach the expectations of an institution.
kids.notes: Student Misconduct Management is concerned with breaches of the student behavioural expectations set out by an institution in its Code of Conduct, Student Charter, Academic Integrity, Harassment, or other relevant statutes, policies, regulations, and guidelines. Student Misconduct Management includes the facilitation of appeal applications and appeal processes.
kids.no_desc: Håndtering av fusk undersøker og fastsetter konsekvenser for tilfeller av studentatferd som bryter med institusjonens forventninger.

kids.en_desc: Examination Management coordinates the planning and conduct of formal learning-assessment activities.
kids.notes: Exams are formal assessments of the learning activities undertaken in curriculum components, usually Subjects. Exams may take many formats, including written, oral or performance, and may be undertaken in person, online, or in hybrid modes, with or without assistance, including assistive technologies. The conduct of examinations may be overseen by invigilation or supervision.
kids.no_desc: Eksamensadministrasjon koordinerer planlegging og gjennomføring av formelle læringsvurderingsaktiviteter.

kids.en_desc: Special Consideration Management assesses and provides adjustments for students experiencing circumstances that require them.
kids.notes: Special circumstances could include the consequences of situations such as medical conditions, loss or bereavement, hardship, and trauma. Special circumstances could also include; being a victim of crime; essential sporting commitments; religious commitments. Assistance arrangements can include examples such as as assistive technology or equipment; flexible attendance requirements; extensions to assessment submissions.
kids.no_desc: Tilrettelegging for særskilte behov vurderer og tilrettelegger justeringer for studenter som opplever omstendigheter som krever det.

kids.en_desc: Cross-Institutional Study manages formal study away from the home institution.
kids.notes: This includes all aspects of managing students formally enrolled at other domestic or overseas institutions for credit towards a qualification at their home institution. May include maintenance of formal agreements such as International Exchange or Study Abroad, or administrative tasks such as student application, admission, enrolment, and transfer and accreditation of results. Cross-Institutional Study may be incoming (i.e., students coming from other institutions) or outgoing (i.e., students going to other institutions).
kids.no_desc: Studentutveksling administrerer formelle studier ved en annen institusjon enn hjeminstitusjonen.

kids.en_desc: Student Liability Management administers the financial dimensions of a student's study.
kids.notes: Participating in higher education can attract many different types of fees, levies, charges, and liabilities, as well as offsetting discounts, waivers, write-offs, sponsorships, and scholarships. Student Liability Management administers the financial dimensions of these, ensuring the correct liability is raised and reported on at the appropriate time with the relevant parties. Liabilities, with or without discounts, can be raised directly with the student, added to a loan or debt scheme, invoiced to a sponsor, or forgiven.
kids.no_desc: Håndtering av studenters økonomiske forpliktelser administrerer de økonomiske aspektene ved en students studier.

kids.en_desc: Financial Aid Management administers all financial support awarded to students.
kids.notes: Financial Aid Management is concerned with all financial support (e.g., Student Loans, Pell Grants, Government "Fees Free" schemes, Gift Aid, Work-Study Agreements, Federal Subsidized Direct Loans). Some interaction is required with the outputs from the Scholarship Management business capability, which is responsible for the acquisition and award of Scholarships.
kids.no: Håndtering av økonomisk støtte til studenter
kids.no_desc: Håndtering av økonomisk støtte administrerer all økonomisk støtte som tildeles studenter.

caps.en_desc: Student Support provides broad academic and personal support to students during their studies.
caps.no_desc: Studentstøtte gir bred akademisk og personlig støtte til studenter under studiene.

kids.en_desc: Academic Advice provides guidance and direction about the Curriculum, academic regulations and policies, and pathways to completion.
kids.notes: Refer also to the adjacent business capability [Student Support].[Core Skills Development].
kids.no_desc: Akademisk veiledning gir veiledning om studieporteføljen, akademiske regler og retningslinjer, og veier til fullføring.

kids.en_desc: Core Skills Development assists students with developing core academic and adjacent skills.
kids.notes: Core skills development includes academic skills such as academic writing and exam preparation, and may include adjacent skills such as leadership, presentation, collaboration, and entrepreneurship.
kids.no_desc: Utvikling av grunnleggende ferdigheter hjelper studenter med å utvikle grunnleggende akademiske ferdigheter.

kids.en_desc: Careers Advice provides information, skills development, and experiences relevant to employability.
kids.notes: Careers Advice provides students with information, advice, guidance, practical skills, and experiences that helps them plan and prepare for their future work and life with the help of information, workshops, events, and services. Careers Advice often works in collaboration with curriculum establishment, volunteering, and placements.
kids.no_desc: Karriererådgivning gir informasjon, ferdighetsutvikling og erfaringer som er relevante for arbeidslivet.

kids.en_desc: Financial Advice offers money-management support and guidance to students of an institution.
kids.notes: Financial Advice typically includes budget advice, resolving funding issues, obtaining information on cost options for housing and transport, and advocating for students applying for emergency funding.
kids.no_desc: Økonomisk rådgivning tilbyr støtte og veiledning i pengeforvaltning til studenter ved en institusjon.

kids.en_desc: Student Grievance Management oversees the resolution of formal complaints submitted to the institution by or concerning students.
kids.notes: Student Grievance Management includes structured case management, escalation procedures, compliance with regulatory requirements, and reporting. It is typically supported by governance or academic policy units and may involve legal or ombuds functions. Student Grievance Management is generally configured to foster constructive outcomes, and to do so in ways that are aligned with institutional values.
kids.no_desc: Klagehåndtering undersøker og behandler formelle klager fra studenter.

caps.en_desc: Student Recruitment promotes an institution and its curriculum to prospective students.
caps.no_desc: Studentrekruttering markedsfører en institusjon og dens studieportefølje til potensielle studenter

kids.en_desc: Domestic Student Recruitment targets promotion of an institution to generate applications specifically from domestic students.
kids.no_desc: Nasjonal studentrekruttering promoterer en institusjon for å generere søknader spesielt fra nasjonale studenter.

kids.en_desc: International Student Recruitment targets promotion of an institution to generate applications specifically from international students.
kids.no_desc: Internasjonal studentrekruttering promoterer en institusjon for å generere søknader spesielt fra internasjonale studenter.

caps.en_desc: Student Admission receives and evaluates applications to admit students to an institution.
caps.notes: The decision to admit a student to an institution may consider a wide range of factors, including entrance merit, the recognition of prior learning, and quota systems that determine the number of available places.
caps.no_desc: Studentopptak mottar og vurderer søknader for å ta opp studenter ved en institusjon.

kids.en_desc: Study Application Management receives, assesses, and responds to applications to study.
kids.no_desc: Søknadsadministrasjon mottar, vurderer og svarer på søknader om opptak til studier.

kids.en_desc: Learning Recognition Management evaluates prior learning and experiences of students and decides on equivalent recognition.
kids.notes: This business capability includes the receipt, assessment, and response to applications for the recognition of prior learning, and maintains transfer-credit-articulation precedent databases and rules, and other evaluation mechanisms as required.
kids.no_desc: Anerkjenne kompetanse vurderer tidligere læring og erfaringer og beslutter tilvarende godkjenning / innpassing

kids.en_desc: Matriculation formally registers a student into an institution.
kids.notes: Matriculation is an ancient concept that today is still celebrated at some institutions by a welcoming ceremony. Ultimately, the process of matriculation confers membership of an institution upon a person who has satisfied the necessary academic and other requirements for entry. The specific business event the defines matriculation does show some variability between institutions and across jurisdictions.
kids.no_desc: Immatrikulering registrerer en student formelt ved en institusjon.

caps.en_desc: Student Enrolment enables students to enrol in curriculum components.
caps.no_desc: Innrullering gjør det mulig for studenter å melde seg på komponenter i studieporteføljen.

kids.en_desc: Enrolment manages the formal registration of students in curriculum components.
kids.no_desc: Registrering og påmelding håndterer den formelle påmeldingen av studenter til studieporteføljekomponenter.

kids.en_desc: Student Allocation places enrolled students into timetabled curriculum components.
kids.notes: Timetabled curriculum components may include Lectures, Tutorials, Laboratories, Seminars, and Practicums, etc, where learning activities, such as group work, presentations, discussions, demonstrations, and experiments will occur.
kids.no_desc: Allokering av studenter fordeler registrerte studenter til timeplanfestede komponenter i studieporteføljen

kids.en_desc: Timetable Management produces and maintains schedules of curriculum component times, resources, and locations.
kids.no_desc: Timeplanlegging utarbeider og vedlikeholder timeplaner for komponenter i studieporteføljen, inkludert tidspunkter, ressurser og lokasjoner.

caps.en_desc: Curriculum Delivery administers and operates the learning opportunities offered by an institution.
caps.no_desc: Levering av studieporteføljen administrerer og gjennomfører læringsmuligheter som tilbys av en institusjon.

kids.en_desc: Learning & Teaching Resource Preparation acquires, assembles, or creates the resources required for learning activities.
kids.notes: Learning resources may support one or many learning activities, and may include resources such as such as books and excerpts, documents, X-Reality experiences, 3D models, access to patients, time on specialised instruments or anything else required to assist the learning activity.
kids.no_desc: Undervisnings og bemanningsplanlegging skaffer, samler eller utvikler ressursene som kreves for læringsaktiviteter.

kids.en_desc: Learning & Teaching Resource Management ensures learning resources are available and accessible for learning activities.
kids.notes: The delivery of learning activities may require learning resources be made available to and accessible by students and staff in relevant learning systems, repositories, and facilities.
kids.no_desc: Forvaltning av undervisningsressurser sikrer at læringsressurser er tilgjengelige og tilrettelagt for læringsaktiviteter.

kids.en_desc: Learning & Teaching Delivery conducts the learning and teaching activities specified in an institution's Curriculum.
kids.no_desc: Formidle læring og undervisning omfatter gjennomføring av lærings- og undervisningsaktivitetene som er spesifisert i institusjonens studieportefølje.

kids.en_desc: Student Supervision provides oversight and mentorship to the academic efforts of students.
kids.notes: Student Supervision is usually arranged in a one-to-one fashion with one academic supervising the academic efforts of one student. Supervision may be applied to academic efforts that are course-, dissertation-, or research-based.
kids.no_desc: Oppfølging av studenter gir tilsyn og veiledning for studentenes akademiske arbeid.

caps.en_desc: Student Assessment evaluates student learning throughout the curriculum.
caps.notes: Student Assessment evaluates student learning across undergraduate, post-graduate, coursework, practical, and research learning, and encompasses both formative, summative, and longitudinal assessment.
caps.no_desc: Studentvurdering evaluerer studentenes læringsutbytte i henhold til studieplanen.

kids.en_desc: Learning Assessment assesses the student's knowledge of learning outcomes.
kids.notes: Learning Assessment is applicable to all curriculum delivery modes, including blended learning and work-based and work-integrated learning.
kids.no_desc: Vurdering av læringsutbytte måler studentens oppnåelse av de definerte læringsmålene.

kids.en_desc: Student Research Assessment evaluates the research outputs of student learning.
kids.notes: Note that student research outputs are related to theses, dissertations, and special topics for doctoral- and masters-level studies. Student research outputs that have been evaluated and found to meet the relevant standard (e.g., discipline, institutional or professional) will often become inputs into BC083 [Research Output Management].
kids.no_desc: Vurdering av studentforskning evaluerer forskningsresultatene fra studentenes læring.

caps.en_desc: Completion Management confirms and recognises completion of study.
caps.notes: Completion Management is responsible for confirming and asserting that a student has achieved the learning outcomes expected from a curriculum component and fulfilled any rules and regulations that might be applicable. In this context, a curriculum component could be a microcredential, a short course, a certificate or diploma, or a traditional degree such as a bachelors, masters, or doctorate.
caps.no_desc: Håndtering av fullføring bekrefter og anerkjenner gjennomføringen av studier.

kids.en_desc: Completion Award assembles and issues credentials that recognise completion of study.
kids.notes: Completion Award is applicable to any learning situation in which a student is issued with a credential, noting that the nature of the credential ranges broadly from a certificate of attendance to a digital badge to an academic transcript to a formal testamur.
kids.no_desc: Bekrefte fullføring utarbeider og utsteder dokumentasjon på fullførte studiekomponenter.

caps.en_desc: Research Opportunities & Planning manages the establishment of the research plan and the resources required to support research.
caps.no_desc: Forskningsmuligheter og planlegging administrerer etableringen av forskningsplanen og ressursene som trengs for å støtte forskningen.

kids.en_desc: Research Opportunity Management explores, identifies, prioritises, and assesses contestable research project opportunities.
kids.no_desc: Forskningsmuligheter utforsker, identifiserer, prioriterer og vurderer forskningsprosjekter med konkurranseutsatte forskningsmuligheter.

kids.en_desc: Collaborative Opportunity Management identifies and manages potential alliances and partnerships required or beneficial to support research.
kids.no_desc: Samarbeidsmuligheter identifiserer og administrerer potensielle allianser og partnerskap som er nødvendige eller fordelaktige for å støtte forskningen.

kids.en_desc: Research Project Design scopes, budgets, and details methodology for research project proposals.
kids.notes: The methodology of a research project includes the agreed protocols for data collection techniques, data management plans, analysis strategies, ethical considerations, and risk assessments.
kids.no_desc: Designe forskningsprosjekt fastsetter omfang, budsjetter og utformer individuelle forskningsprosjekter som foreslås innenfor forskningsprogrammet.

caps.en_desc: Research Funding acquires financial resources required to support research, training, and service through various agreements.
caps.no_desc: Forskningsfinansiering skaffer økonomiske ressurser som er nødvendige for å støtte forskning, opplæring og tjenester gjennom ulike avtaler.

kids.en_desc: Research Fund Sourcing identifies and secures financial resources required to support research, training, and service through various agreements.
kids.no_desc: Innhente finansiering identifiserer og sikrer finansielle ressurser som kreves for å understøtte forskning, opplæring og tjenester gjennom ulike avtaler.

kids.en_desc: Research Grant Management administers the research grants an institution is a party to.
kids.no_desc: Forskningsbevilgninger administrerer forskningsbevilgninger som institusjonen er part i.

caps.en_desc: Research Assurance manages frameworks and expectations for the responsible and compliant conduct of an institution's research activities.
caps.no_desc: Forskningssikring styrer rammeverk og forventninger for ansvarlig gjennomføring av institusjonens forskningsaktiviteter i tråd med gjeldende lover og regler.

kids.en_desc: Research Performance Management assesses the performance of an institution's research activities and undertakes performance improvement.
kids.no_desc: Forskningsmål- og resultatstyring vurderer ytelsen til institusjonens forskningsaktiviteter og gjennomfører tiltak for forbedring av prestasjonene.

kids.en_desc: Research Quality Management assesses the quality of research activity in which an institution participates and undertakes quality improvement activities.
kids.no_desc: Kvalitetssikring av forskning vurderer kvaliteten på forskningsaktivitetene institusjonen deltar i og gjennomfører tiltak for kvalitetsforbedring.

kids.en_desc: Research Ethics Management assesses and monitors the ethical clearance of research proposals.
kids.notes: Research Ethics Management considers the methodology and techniques of sensitive research proposals --- typically those involving human subjects and animal subjects. Additionally, the ethical posture of active research projects is monitored by and reported upon by Research Ethics Management.
kids.no_desc: Håndtering av forskningsetikk vurderer og overvåker etisk godkjenning av forskningsforslag.

kids.en_desc: Research Integrity Management defines and supports an institution's expectations for how research activities are conducted.
kids.notes: Research Integrity Management is applicable throughout the full research process, including the planning and conduct of research, the recording and reporting of results, and the dissemination, application, and exploitation of research findings.
kids.no_desc: Forskningsintegritet definerer og støtter institusjonens forventninger til hvordan forskningsaktiviteter skal gjennomføres.

caps.en_desc: Research Activity manages the undertaking of systematic investigation.
caps.notes: Research Activity manages the active aspects of the research project lifecycle and attempts to provide conditions that maximise opportunities for the delivery of valid and valuable research outputs. Research activities can be found in all scholarly fields, and may include scientific experiments, social science surveys, historical research, and other structured techniques.
caps.no_desc: Forskningsaktivitet administrerer gjennomføringen av systematisk undersøkelse.

kids.en_desc: Research Creation comprises activities of systematic investigation that are designed to create new knowledge, concepts, methodologies, inventions, and understandings.
kids.notes: Research Creation may include conducting experiments, observations, and simulations; interviews and surveys; processing outputs; analysing information; meta-analysis; longitudinal studies; recording findings; and other research-creation activities and undertakings.
kids.no_desc: Forskning omfatter aktiviteter for systematisk undersøkelse som er utformet for å skape ny kunnskap, konsepter, metodologier, oppfinnelser og forståelser.

kids.en_desc: Research Data Management manages the storage, classification, categorisation, usage, preservation, and sharing of datasets throughout the research lifecycle.
kids.notes: Research Data Management involves the planning and management of research data during the lifetime of a research project. It involves decisions about how data will be preserved and shared after the project is completed (e.g., depositing data into a repository for long-term archiving and access). Increasingly, the principles of FAIR[ER] and CARE play a significant role in determining exactly how and under what conditions research data will be handled, managed, and stored. Research Data Management is concerned with all research data and associated metadata created by research activity, preferably in accordance with developed and agreed dataset management plans.
kids.no_desc: Håndtering av forskningsdata styrer lagring, klassifisering, kategorisering, bruk, bevaring og deling av datasett gjennom forskningslivssyklusen.

kids.en_desc: Research Infrastructure Management oversees the lifecycle and governance of an institution's research platforms, research facilities, and research instrumentation.
kids.notes: The scope of Research Infrastructure is broad, and includes instrumentation and knowledge-based resources, laboratories and libraries, field sites and sensor networks, e-science systems and tools, submarines and spacecraft. Research Infrastructure Management may include the governance and access-and-charging arrangements for third-party use of an institution's research infrastructure.
kids.no_desc: Forvaltning av forskningsinfrastruktur administrerer og styrer livssyklusen til institusjonens fasiliteter, ressurser og tilknyttede tjenester som brukes til å utføre forskning.

kids.en_desc: Research Resource Management acquires, creates, and manages resources required for research creation.
kids.notes: Research Resources include materials such as chemicals, reagents, and animal colonies.
kids.no_desc: Administrasjon av forskningsressurser skaffer, skaper og administrerer ressurser som er nødvendige for gjennomføring av forskning.

caps.en_desc: Research Management enables and facilitates the administrative and operational functions required to support research activity.
caps.no_desc: Forskningsadministrasjon muliggjør og fasiliterer de administrative og operasjonelle funksjonene som kreves for å støtte forskningsaktiviteter.

kids.en_desc: Research Programme Management facilitates and supports operational activities, compliance concerns, and delivery outcomes for research programmes throughout their lifecycle.
kids.notes: Research Programme Management is applicable to the full research lifecycle, both pre-award (e.g., overarching programme coordination of early-lifecycle activities such as capability planning and funding-opportunity identification) and post-award (e.g., overarching programme coordination of late-lifecycle activities such as technology transfer and effecting desirable research outcomes).
kids.no_desc: Forskningsprogramledelse støtter og tilrettelegger for operasjonelle aktiviteter, overholdelse av regelverk og leveranseresultater for forskningsprogrammer gjennom hele deres livssyklus.

kids.en_desc: Research Funds Management manages the revenue and expenditure related to an institution's research projects or individual grants.
kids.notes: Research Funds Management includes the management of research contracts and revenue milestones.
kids.no_desc: Håndtering av forskningsfinansiering styrer inntekter og utgifter knyttet til institusjonens forskningsprosjekter eller individuelle stipender.

caps.en_desc: Research Dissemination manages the sharing of research findings with target audiences.
caps.notes: Research Dissemination spans the planning, conduct, and tracking of the publishing, announcing, and communication of research initiatives and research findings in both traditional media (e.g., research journals and books, conferences and meetings, websites and blogs) and in other media (e.g., community engagement and storytelling, social media, and a widely-accessible range of public-speaking opportunities).
caps.no_desc: Forskningsformidling håndterer deling av forskningsfunn med aktuelle målgrupper.

kids.en_desc: Research Output Management assembles, records, publishes, and curates research outputs.
kids.notes: The Research Output Management business capability includes the application and management of bibliometric techniques such as citation and attribution metrics. Research Output Management is generally applicable to works of all types (such as those detailed in the ORCID scheme detailed at https://info.orcid.org/ufaqs/what-work-types-does-orcid-support/).
kids.no_desc: Håndtering av forskningsresultater samler, registrerer, publiserer og kuraterer resultater fra forskning.

kids.en_desc: Research Commercialisation Management manages the realisation and exploitation of research outcomes for profit.
kids.no_desc: Kommersialisering av forskning realiserer og utnytter forskningsresultater for økonomisk gevinst.

kids.en_desc: Research Impact Management identifies, assesses, and tracks the impact of research on the broader community across cultural, economic, environmental, social, legal, political, and technological dimensions.
kids.no_desc: Forvaltning av forskningens samfunnseffekt identifiserer, vurderer og følger opp forskningens påvirkning på samfunnet innenfor kulturelle, økonomiske, miljømessige, sosiale, juridiske, politiske og teknologiske dimensjoner.

kids.en_desc: Research Outcome Management identifies, defines, and tracks an institution's research outcomes.
kids.no_desc: Forvaltning av forskningens virkning identifiserer, definerer og følger opp virkning av institusjonens forskning.

caps.en_desc: Marketing Management identifies target markets and designs and oversees the execution of activities that promote an institution's products and services.
caps.notes: Some of the goals Marketing Management has are to enable the understanding of customer and stakeholder requirements to position products and services to meet customer requirements, and to develop and maintain brand equity and consistency.
caps.no_desc: Markedsføring målmarkeder og utformer og overvåker gjennomføringen av aktiviteter som fremmer institusjonens produkter og tjenester.

kids.en_desc: Advertising Management develops and manages advertising, including setting objectives, messages, audience, and engaging advertising and media providers.
kids.no_desc: Annonsering utvikler og administrerer annonsering, inkludert fastsetting av mål, budskap, målgruppe og samarbeid med reklame- og medieleverandører.

kids.en_desc: Campaign Management prepares, launches, monitors, and reviews targeted promotional activities.
kids.no_desc: Kampanjer forbereder, lanserer, overvåker og vurderer målrettede kampanjeaktiviteter.

kids.en_desc: Market Research gathers and analyses information about target markets and customers in order to assess market demand, size, and competition.
kids.no_desc: Markedsundersøkelser samler og analyserer informasjon om målmarkeder og kunder for å vurdere etterspørsel, markedets størrelse og konkurranse.

kids.en_desc: Merchandising develops, manages, and sells institution merchandise.
kids.no_desc: Varer utvikler, administrerer og selger institusjonens produkter.

kids.en_desc: Brand Management governs and measures the use and market performance of an institution's brands.
kids.notes: Brand Management builds brand associations, images, awareness, and loyalty of an institution's brands, resulting in increased perceived value over time. Brand Management is concerned with the perception, value, and equity of an institution's brands, and works to ensure brand use is appropriate and consistent and that brand evolution results in desirable outcomes. The ability to differentiate one from another the various brands an institution operates is also an important feature of this business capability.
kids.no_desc: Merkevarehåndtering styrer og måler bruken og markedsprestasjonen til en institusjons merkevarer.

caps.en_desc: Auxiliary Capabilities provide essential foundational support to an institution's core value chains and enabling business capabilities.
caps.no_desc: Støttetjenester inkluderer et bredt spekter av forretningskapabiliteter som støtter institusjonen i å drifte sine verdikjeder og tilretteleggende funksjoner.

kids.en_desc: Event Management is the development and execution of events such as ceremonies and conferences.
kids.no_desc: Arrangementer omfatter utvikling og gjennomføring av arrangementer som seremonier og konferanser.

kids.en_desc: Housing & Accommodation Management arranges and manages the provision of accommodation to an institution's students, staff, and visitors.
kids.notes: Housing & Accommodation Management accepts and assesses for places in an institution's owned, leased, and brokered accommodation holdings. This business capability often works in conjunction with the study-application processes for students and talent-acquisition processes for staff, and may also be involved in finding accommodation solutions for conference and event attendees. Some institutions also make their owned accommodation stocks available to members of the public during non-teaching times. The provision of housekeeping and meals is typically available within institution-owned accommodation, such as dormitories, halls of residence, and motel- and hotel-style offerings.
kids.no_desc: Boligformidling organiserer og administrerer tilbudet av bolig og overnatting for institusjonens studenter, ansatte og besøkende.

kids.en_desc: Gallery & Museum Management designs, operates, and curates exhibitions.
kids.notes: The exhibitions may be drawn from the institution's own and external or travelling special collections of artefacts, objects, and digital objects such as artworks, ephemera, scientific, cultural, heritage, and other natures, typically in dedicated gallery and museum facilities, and also in temporary, pop-up, and cabinet displays.
kids.no_desc: Administrasjon av gallerier og museum utformer, drifter og kuraterer utstillinger.

kids.en_desc: Childcare Management provides students, staff, and other constituents of an institution with access to childcare services.
kids.no_desc: Barnepass gir studenter, ansatte og andre tilknyttet institusjonen tilgang til barnehagetjenester.

kids.en_desc: Healthcare Management provides eligible constituents of an institution with healthcare services such as a general medical practice and counselling services.
kids.no_desc: Bedriftshelsetjenester tilbyr kvalifiserte personer ved institusjonen helsetjenester som allmennmedisin og rådgivningstjenester.

kids.en_desc: Sport & Recreation Management provides sport and recreational facilities and services.
kids.no_desc: Trening og avkobling tilbyr idretts- og fritidsfasiliteter og -tjenester

kids.en_desc: Venue Management includes activities related to the operations of facilities such as performance theatres, reception halls, sports arenas, and conference centres, for the purposes of transient or short-term events.
kids.no_desc: Lokaler inkluderer aktiviteter knyttet til drift av fasiliteter som teatersaler, mottakshaller, idrettsarenaer og konferansesentre for kortvarige eller midlertidige arrangementer.

kids.en_desc: Retail Management enables the sale of goods and services through an institution's physical and online channels.
kids.no_desc: Salg av varer og tjenester muliggjør salg av varer og tjenester gjennom institusjonens fysiske og nettbaserte kanaler.

kids.en_desc: Membership Management manages membership of constituents to an institution's services.
kids.no_desc: Medlemsskapstjenester håndterer medlemskap for personer som benytter institusjonens tjenester.

kids.en_desc: Campus Transportation Management determines the range and nature of transportation modes and services availability for people to travel to, within, and between an institution's campuses.
kids.notes: This capability may incorporate traditional car-parking schemes, interactions and agreement with public-transport providers, arrangements for bicycle users, and the adoption and promotion of mobility-as-service transport options such as pay-per-use e-scooters.
kids.no_desc: Transport og parkering fastsetter hvilke transportmoduser og -tjenester som skal være tilgjengelige for personer som reiser til, innenfor og mellom institusjonens campuser.

kids.en_desc: Health, Safety, & Wellbeing Management identifies, manages, investigates, and monitors risks to the health, safety, and environment of all people engaged in institutional activities or located at institutional locations.
kids.notes: These services contribute to improving and promoting the physical, mental, and cultural health, safety, and environments for staff and for students through training, wellness activities, sustainability initiatives, and risk management.
kids.no_desc: Helse, miljø og sikkerhet identifiserer, håndterer, undersøker og overvåker risiko knyttet til helse, sikkerhet og miljø for alle som deltar i institusjonens aktiviteter eller oppholder seg på institusjonens lokasjoner.

kids.en_desc: Travel Management manages an institution's travel programme.
kids.notes: Travel Management coordinates with other business capabilities to manage the institution's strategic approach to travel (including sustainability implications), travel-vendor relationships, traveller safety and security, and travel and expenses data management.
kids.no_desc: Reisetjenester administrerer institusjonens reiseprogram

kids.en_desc: Intercollegiate Athletics Management provides the sports-specific organisation, governance, and programmes that structure, develop, and enable competitive sports and games.
kids.notes: Intercollegiate Athletics Management is applicable to all forms of sport and games (e.g., football and chess, track and esports, weightlifting and darts, cricket, fencing, and rowing). This capability is concerned with sport governance, coaching, compliance, and ethics, and with sports-specific considerations of ethics, equity, recruitment, administration, marketing, and negotiation of media rights.
kids.no_desc: Toppidret organiserer og styrer sportslige aktiviteter, programmer og konkurranser som strukturerer, utvikler og muliggjør konkurranseidrett og spill.

kids.en_desc: Publishing Management acquires, develops, and produces works for publication.
kids.notes: Publishing Management is often instantiated within higher-education institutions as a University Press or similar, and the works considered for publication are typically of a scholarly, cultural, and specialised nature. Scholarly works include monographs, journals, edited volumes, digital open-access publications, and Open Educational Resources.
kids.no_desc: Anskaffer, utvikler og produserer verk for publisering.

kids.en_desc: Delivery & Distribution oversees and facilitates the movement of mail and goods into, within, and out of the institution.
kids.notes: Delivery & Distribution encompasses the receipt, storage, internal routing, and despatch of a wide range of items from letters and packages to materials and consumables, specialised equipment, and regulated goods. It includes coordination of distribution channels and compliance with postal, safety, and logistics requirements.
kids.no_desc: Overvåker og legger til rette for transport og distribusjon av post og varer til, innenfor og fra institusjonen.

caps.en_desc: Facilities & Estate Management oversees and maintains an institution's physical estate, property, and facilities.
caps.no_desc: Eiendom og fysisk campus administrerer og vedlikeholder institusjonens fysiske eiendommer, eiendom og fasiliteter.

kids.en_desc: Facilities Management provides the operational lifecycle management of an institution's physical environment.
kids.notes: The ISO definition notes that terms "Facility Management" and "Facilities Management" are used interchangeably, and offers that "Facility Management is an organizational function which integrates people, place, and process within the built environment with the purpose of improving the quality of life of people and the productivity of the core business." Facility Management is typically focused upon optimising the functionality, safety, sustainability, and efficiency of an institution's facilities estate.
kids.no_desc: Bygnings- og teknisk forvaltning gir operasjonell livssyklusforvaltning av institusjonens fysiske miljø.

kids.en_desc: Property Management oversees the institution's real-estate portfolio.
kids.notes: Property Management generally seeks to to maximise the financial performance and optimise the use of an institution's property and land holdings. This typically includes the provision of strategic and professional advice and support in relation to the purchase, leasing, and disposal of properties.
kids.no_desc: Areal og eiendomsforvaltningovervåker institusjonens eiendomsportefølje.

kids.en_desc: Campus Security Management provides and manages institution security services for safety and protection of people and assets.
kids.notes: Campus Security Management may include physical security presence and monitoring, building access management, and incident and emergency response management.
kids.no_desc: Vakthold, adgang og sikkerhet tilbyr og administrerer institusjonens sikkerhetstjenester for å sikre sikkerhet og beskyttelse av mennesker og eiendeler.

kids.en_desc: Commercial Tenancy Management identifies needs and opportunities for commercial and retail operators, research partners, and other higher-education parties to occupy and use institution-owned spaces.
kids.notes: Commercial Tenancy Management will usually also be concerned with ensuring occupancy of institution-owned spaces meet all relevant requirements.
kids.no_desc: Utleievirksomhet identifiserer behov og muligheter for kommersielle og detaljhandelsoperatører, forskningspartnere og andre aktører innen høyere utdanning til å benytte institusjonseide lokaler.

kids.en_desc: Cleaning & Waste Management provides and manages the cleaning, waste removal, and recycling services for an institution.
kids.no_desc: Renhold leverer og administrerer rengjørings-, avfalls- og resirkuleringstjenester for en institusjon.

kids.en_desc: Groundskeeping Management provides upkeep and maintenance of the grounds, parks, and botanical assets of an institution's estate.
kids.no_desc: Park og områdevedlikehold sørger for vedlikehold og opparbeidelse av institusjonens uteområder, parker og botaniske eiendeler.

kids.en_desc: Environmental Sustainability Management measures and manages the direct consumption or production of utilities and resources across an institution's estate and the indirect consumption of resources attributable to an institution's business activities.
kids.notes: Environmental Sustainability Management is concerned with the consumption of utilities and resources (such as water, electricity, gases, and paper) and with the environmental cost of an institution's business activities (such as carbon emissions, transport choices, and travel posture).
kids.no_desc: Klima, miljø og bærekraft måler og styrer institusjonens direkte forbruk eller produksjon av ressurser og tjenester over hele eiendommen, samt det indirekte ressursforbruket knyttet til institusjonens virksomhet.

kids.en_desc: Space Utilisation Management analyses, plans, and allocates the use of physical spaces by an institution.
kids.notes: Capability necessary to analyse, plan, review, and measure space usage (i.e., purpose) and utilisation (i.e., time in use), including spatial analytics. Forecasts can include assessment of space fit and occupancy against utilisation, to optimise usage and meet future demands.
kids.no_desc: Arealbruk analyserer, planlegger og allokerer bruken av fysiske rom ved en institusjon.

caps.en_desc: Library Management provides strategic oversight and operational stewardship of an institution's scholarly resources.
caps.notes: Institutional libraries usually provide services to the institution's staff and students, approved readers and academic visitors, and members of the public. This includes the stewardship and curation of physical and digital collections, user services, systems and platforms (e.g., discovery tools, repositories), space provision and planning, and support of teaching, research, and community engagement.
caps.no_desc: Biblioteksadministrasjon tilbyr strategisk overblikk og operasjonell forvaltning av en institusjons akademiske ressurser.

kids.en_desc: Collection Access Management manages entitlements and enables authorised access to collections.
kids.notes: Collection Access Management manages secure, equitable, and seamless access to library and archive collections — both physical and digital. It manages user entitlements, authentication, licensing, compliance, and permissions across platforms and formats, enabling the discovery and use of resources such as e-books, journals, digitised archives, research data, and multimedia content. These collections may be internal or external to the institutions, and may also be made available through authentication, inter-library loans, reciprocal access schemes, and collaborative initiatives.
kids.no_desc: Tilgang til samlinger administrerer rettigheter og muliggjør tilgang til samlinger.

kids.en_desc: Library Collection Management provides the strategic curation and lifecycle-management of an institution's library collections.
kids.notes: Library Collection Management includes a diverse range of physical and digital assets and things, such as books, journals, theses, special collections, research outputs, Open Educational Resources, multimedia content, and institutional and historical archives.
kids.no_desc: Samlingsforvaltning kuraterer og administrerer livssyklusen til samlinger som holdes av institusjonens biblioteker.

caps.en_desc: Information Management describes, organises, distributes, and governs information.
caps.notes: Information management entails all the resources, (staff, equipment, processes, information systems, data repositories) that are deployed by an organisation to render information discoverable, accessible, intelligible, relevant, trustworthy and affordable. Educational organisations are highly dependent on information and systems that automate their use of information. As a result information management is a capability with a large number of concerns and specialisations, that are in some cases highly distributed, and in others concentrated on highly specialised organisational functions.
caps.no_desc: Informasjonsstyring beskriver, organiserer, distribuerer og styrer informasjon.

kids.en_desc: Information Governance defines the roles and responsibilities, decision rights and controls, and processes used to manage information assets.
kids.notes: Information Governance is applicable to all types of structured and unstructured information, and to any conceivable source of information the institution creates or acquires. How information governance is realised will vary greatly between organisations. It may include controls, such as policies and procedures, that are applied in a distributed manner to many processes and functions across the institution. It may also include specific sub-capabilities with dedicated processes, tools and staff — such as master data management and data classification systems. Finally, institutions may have a matrix of formal activities to ensure information management controls specific are visible to the organisation. These are usually some form of data stewardship programs. In all cases the object of this capability is behaviour. Specifically the behaviours of people that directly affect the value of information in the institution.
kids.no_desc: Informasjonsforvaltning definerer roller og ansvar, beslutningsrettigheter og kontrollmekanismer, samt prosesser for å forvalte informasjonsressurser.

kids.en_desc: Information Security Management protects the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information in an institution's care.
kids.notes: Cybersecurity is the related technical discipline responsible for the protection of ICT infrastructure, systems, and networks against unauthorised access or criminal use.
kids.no_desc: Informasjonssikkerhet beskytter konfidensialiteten, integriteten og tilgjengeligheten av informasjon som institusjonen har ansvar for.

kids.en_desc: Identity & Access Management manages information about people and things, instantiates and enforces organisational business rules and policy regarding entitlements to systems and services, and mediates access requests and identity verification.
kids.no_desc: Identitets- og tilgangskontroll administrerer informasjon om personer og ting, håndhever institusjonelle regler og policyer angående rettigheter til systemer og tjenester, og behandler tilgangsforespørsler og identitetsverifisering.

kids.en_desc: Artefact & Collection Management acquires, catalogues, maintains, and preserves an institution's collections.
kids.notes: Artefact & Collection Management is an integrated approach to developing, caring for, documenting, and using collections. In addition to typical collections such as those acquired and lifecycle-managed by an academic library, the items contained within these collections may be physical artefacts of special character and value, such as artworks, letters, cultural artefacts, and botanical or biological specimens.
kids.no_desc: Museum og samlinger skaffer, katalogiserer, vedlikeholder og bevarer institusjonens samlinger.

kids.en_desc: Intellectual Property Management protects the works and assets created by an institution and facilitates institutional compliance with its use of works and assets created elsewhere.
kids.notes: The applicability of Intellectual Property Management includes copyrighting and trademarking and patenting and also whatever protections a creator chooses from Creative Commons or alternative copyleft schemes. In higher education, this also includes the management of rights for digitised collections, scholarly works, repository content, born-digital scholarly outputs, digital asset management, and content services. This capability forms the basis of enabling lawful reuse, licensing, and long-term access.
kids.no_desc: Opphavsrett og immaterielle rettigheter beskytter verk og eiendeler opprettet av en institusjon og sikrer institusjonens samsvar med bruk av verk og eiendeler opprettet av andre.

kids.en_desc: Data Management plans, creates or acquires, stores, uses, archives, and disposes of data.
kids.notes: The DAMA definition of Data Management is "the development, execution, and supervision of plans, policies, programs, and practices that deliver, control, protect, and enhance the value of data and information assets throughout their lifecycles.", from the DMBOKv2.
kids.no_desc: Datahåndtering planlegger, oppretter eller anskaffer, lagrer, bruker, arkiverer og sletter data.

kids.en_desc: Advanced Analytics produces insights and information assets using sophisticated analysis techniques on diverse data sets.
kids.no_desc: Avansert informasjonsanalyse skaper innsikt og informasjonsressurser ved hjelp av avanserte analyseteknikker på ulike datasett.

kids.en_desc: Records Management provides the systematic control and governance of an institution's records and associated information.
kids.notes: Records Management is applicable to all records, regardless of format, throughout their entire life cycle. That life cycle includes processes creation, receipt, classification, maintenance, use, storage, retrieval, access, and, as directed by relevant recordskeeping obligations, either destruction or permanent retention.
kids.no_desc: Journaler, transaksjoner og logger håndterer opprettelse, mottak, vedlikehold, bruk og avhending av arkiver, inkludert prosesser for å dokumentere og opprettholde bevis og informasjon om forretningsaktiviteter og transaksjoner i form av arkiver.

kids.en_desc: Enterprise Content Management captures, stores, manages, and delivers content and documents that support an institution's key business processes.
kids.no_desc: Innholdsforvaltning fanger opp, lagrer, administrerer og leverer innhold og dokumenter som støtter en institusjons nøkkelprosesser.

kids.en_desc: Business Intelligence & Reporting collects, analyses, and transforms data and presents business information.
kids.notes: Business Intelligence & Reporting provides products and presentation artefacts that support storytelling, communication, and decision-making with strategic insights that enable evidence-based planning, operational monitoring, and the communication of business performance.
kids.no_desc: Rapportering og analyse samler inn, analyserer og presenterer informasjon.

kids.en_desc: Digital Preservation manages and maintains digital objects so they can be accessed and used in the future.
kids.notes: Digital Preservation ensures the long-term accessibility and usability of digital objects by safeguarding them against technological obsolescence and media degradation. Digital Preservation of digital objects may include a range of assets including student records, institutional archives, research data, and relevant library and archive collections.
kids.no_desc: Digital arkivering innebærer aktiv og bevisst forvaltning og vedlikehold av digitale objekter (filer med digital informasjon) slik at de kan være tilgjengelige og brukes av fremtidige brukere.

kids.en_desc: Archive Management provides for the systematic preservation of and provision of access to records deemed to be permanently valuable.
kids.notes: Archive Management includes the appraisal and selection of records for long-term preservation, accessioning and cataloguing archival materials, preservation and conservation of physical and digital archives, and the management of archival metadata and discovery aids to facilitate access. Records selected for archiving will usually have enduring historical, evidential, or informational importance. Archives Management coordinates with Records Management and Digital Preservation, and ensures compliance with legal, regulatory, and institutional requirements.
kids.no_desc: Sørger for systematisk bevaring av og tilgang til arkivmateriale som anses å ha varig verdi.

caps.en_desc: Strategy Management defines the direction of an institution and its strategic initiatives.
caps.notes: Strategy Management is applicable to an institution as a whole, and may also be scoped to specific organisational units or particular functions. The desirable outcome of strategy management is usually aligning goals with vision and mission.
caps.no_desc: Forvaltning av virksomhetsstrategi definerer retningen for en institusjon og dens strategiske initiativer.

kids.en_desc: Vision & Strategy Development defines the long-term direction and broadly identifies the activities to be pursued and the business capabilities to be developed.
kids.no_desc: Utvikling av strategi og visjon definerer den langsiktige retningen og identifiserer overordnet hvilke aktiviteter som skal gjennomføres og hvilke forretningskapabiliteter som skal utvikles.

kids.en_desc: Strategic Plan Management identifies, reviews, and updates the specific strategic initiatives that achieve the vision and strategy.
kids.no_desc: Forvaltning av strategisk plan identifiserer, vurderer og oppdaterer de spesifikke strategiske initiativene som realiserer visjonen og strategien.

caps.en_desc: Legal Affairs manages and advises an institution on legal matters.
caps.no_desc: Juridiske tjenester administrerer og gir råd til en institusjon i juridiske spørsmål.

kids.en_desc: Contract Management manages the development, negotiation, execution, and review of institution contracts.
kids.no_desc: Kontraktshåndtering administrerer utvikling, forhandling, gjennomføring og gjennomgang av institusjonens kontrakter.

kids.en_desc: Legal Advisory provides legal advice to support institution operations and decision-making.
kids.no_desc: Juridisk rådgivning gir juridisk rådgivning for å støtte institusjonens drift og beslutningstaking.

kids.en_desc: Dispute Resolution facilitates mediation, arbitration, and other processes to settle matters without litigation.
kids.no_desc: Tilrettelegger for mekling, voldgift og andre prosesser for å løse tvister uten bruk av rettsapparatet.

kids.en_desc: Litigation Management facilitates the institution's participation in court or tribunal proceedings.
kids.notes: Litigation Management includes defining the tactical approach, representation, and case management for litigation.
kids.no_desc: Tilrettelegger for institusjonens deltakelse i rettssaker og saker for domstoler og andre tvisteløsningsorganer.

caps.en_desc: Governance, Risk, & Compliance performs governance, risk management, and compliance activities.
caps.no_desc: Styring, risiko og etterlevelse (GRC) utfører aktiviteter innen styring, risikohåndtering og etterlevelse.

kids.en_desc: Business Continuity Management develops, tests, and maintains an institution's business continuity plans.
kids.no_desc: Kontinuitetsplanlegging utvikler, tester og vedlikeholder en institusjons planer for virksomhetskontinuitet.

kids.en_desc: Internal Audit manages and delivers the internal audit programme.
kids.no_desc: Internrevisjon håndterer og leverer program for internrevisjon.

kids.en_desc: Policy Management governs the development, establishment, amendment, and review of policies to ensure relevance, authority, and consistency with internal and external legislation, and defines the roles, responsibilities, and authorities in relation to the development, establishment, amendment, and review of policies.
kids.no_desc: Policyforvaltning regulerer utarbeidelse, etablering, endring og gjennomgang av retningslinjer for å sikre relevans, autoritet og samsvar med internt og eksternt regelverk, samt definerer roller, ansvar og myndighet i forbindelse med utarbeidelse, etablering, endring og gjennomgang av retningslinjer.

kids.en_desc: Quality Management manages, monitors, maintains, and improves relevant internal standards an institution sets, and responds to external standards.
kids.no_desc: Kvalitetsstyring administrerer, overvåker, vedlikeholder og forbedrer relevante interne standarder satt av institusjonen, samt ivaretar og responderer på eksterne standarder.

kids.en_desc: Complaint & Compliment Management receives and responds to unsolicited feedback related to the institution.
kids.notes: Complaint & Compliment Management receives feedback from any individual or group, and makes responses to feedback only when the institution chooses to do so.
kids.no_desc: Håndtering av tilbakemeldinger mottar, anerkjenner og besvarer både positive og negative tilbakemeldinger fra samfunnet.

kids.en_desc: Investigation Management manages investigations in respect of specified aspects of an institution's operations.
kids.no_desc: Internkontroll administrerer undersøkelser og tilsyn relatert til spesifikke aspekter av en institusjons drift.

kids.en_desc: Risk Management identifies, evaluates, and prioritises uncertainties that could affect an institution's ability to achieve its objectives.
kids.notes: Risk Management includes strategic and operational risks across all institutional activities, including Learning & Teaching and Research. Risk Management also establishes and monitors controls that mitigate the potential effects of those uncertainties.
kids.no_desc: Risikostyring identifiserer, vurderer og prioriterer usikkerheter som kan påvirke institusjonens evne til å nå sine mål.

kids.en_desc: Compliance Management ensures an institution operates within the bounds of prescribed rules and obligations.
kids.notes: These rules and obligations arise from internal and external sources including governments, regulatory bodies, and employee unions. The scope of this capability includes the creation and delivery of any statutory reporting that might be required.
kids.no_desc: Etterlevelse sikrer at en institusjon opererer innenfor rammene av fastsatte regler og forpliktelser.

kids.en_desc: Incident Management prepares for and responds to adverse events, unplanned disruptions, or imminent threats to services, operations, safety, or property.
kids.no_desc: Hendelseshåndtering forbereder på og håndterer uforutsette hendelser, forstyrrelser eller trusler mot tjenester, drift, sikkerhet eller eiendom.

caps.en_desc: Human Resource Management encompasses strategic and operational activities related to the institution's workforce.
caps.notes: Human Resource Management covers a wide range of activities including recruitment and selection of employees, performance management, compensation, training and development, career support, team development, communication and conflict, industrial negotiation, resolution, and HR strategy.
caps.no_desc: Personalledelse HR- og HMS administrerer strategiske og operative funksjoner knyttet til menneskelig kapital i en institusjon.

kids.en_desc: Organisational Design defines the structures, roles, and practices of an institution.
kids.notes: Organisational Design is charged with considering many factors, such as institution-level change, organisational structure, desired operating model, technology, culture, power, and the external environment.
kids.no_desc: Organisasjonsutvikling definerer strukturer, roller og praksiser for en institusjon.

kids.en_desc: Workforce Relations Management manages industrial and labour relations between an institution, its workforce, and their representatives.
kids.notes: Workforce Relations Management plays a pivotal role in scenarios such as institutional restructure, in which it partners with other capabilities such as [Workforce Planning], [Organisational Design], and, from [Business Capability Management], [Change Management]. Representatives in these processes include unions, lawyers, and other individual or collective representatives.
kids.no_desc: Arbeidsgiverforhold og ansattrelasjoner administrerer industrielle og arbeidsforhold mellom institusjonen, dens ansatte og deres representante

kids.en_desc: Workforce Planning forecasts workforce requirements and recommends workforce structuring and recruitment strategies.
kids.no_desc: Bemanningsstrategi og rekrutteringsplaner prognostiserer arbeidskraftbehov og anbefaler strategier for arbeidskraftstruktur og rekruttering.

kids.en_desc: Talent Acquisition identifies, assesses, hires, and onboards prospective candidates into an institution's workforce.
kids.no_desc: Rekruttering identifiserer, vurderer og ansetter kandidater og introduserer dem som ansatte i institusjonen.

kids.en_desc: Remuneration & Benefits Management plans, manages, calibrates, and monitors remuneration, entitlements, and other benefits.
kids.no_desc: Remuneration & Benefits Management planlegger, administrerer, kalibrerer og overvåker ansattes lønn, rettigheter og andre fordeler.

kids.en_desc: Workforce Resource Management allocates work amongst the staff and other members of an institution.
kids.notes: Workforce Resource Management includes allocation based upon time, availability, preference, and skills, and incorporates rostering-based allocation and skills-and-priorities-based allocation. Tracking time spent and progress achieved is also included in the scope of this capability, whether for time-and-attendance (as an input to Payroll) or activity-based records (to support cost recovery or to serve as an input to workforce planning and workforce optimisation).
kids.no_desc: Ressursplanlegging fordeler arbeidsoppgaver blant ansatte og andre medlemmer av institusjonen.

kids.en_desc: Workforce Performance Management assesses, manages, rewards, and recognises the performance of the workforce.
kids.no_desc: Medarbeiderutvikling vurderer, administrerer, belønner og anerkjenner prestasjonene til ansatte og andre i arbeidsstyrken

kids.en_desc: Workforce Training & Development determines, builds, delivers, and records the outcomes of professional development and training.
kids.notes: Alongside the management of professional development and training, accreditations, and certifications for formally-employed members of the institution's workforce, the scope of this business capability also includes contracted workers, research students, and other third parties as may be required.
kids.no_desc: Kurs og opplæring fastsetter, utvikler, leverer og dokumenterer resultatene av faglig utvikling og opplæring.

kids.en_desc: Human Resource Support manages and advises on workforce casework.
kids.notes: Human Resource Support includes advisory practices for front-line managers and operational activities such as grievance processes, counselling services, and mediation services, etc.
kids.no_desc: HR-støtte tilbyr bistand og støtte til ansatte i form av klageprosesser, rådgivningstjenester, meklingstjenester osv., og gir rådgivning til linjeledere i spørsmål om arbeidsstyringsproblemer.

caps.en_desc: Financial Management oversees, plans and controls all aspects of an institution's finances.
caps.no_desc: Økonomi administrerer alle aspekter av en institusjons økonomi.

kids.en_desc: Accounts Payable manages the payment of current debts and liabilities of an institution.
kids.no_desc: Leverandørreskontro administrerer betalingen av institusjonens nåværende gjeld og forpliktelser.

kids.en_desc: Accounts Receivable manages the receipt of payments to an institution.
kids.no_desc: Kundereskontro administrerer mottak av betalinger til institusjonen.

kids.en_desc: Price Modelling models various product-pricing scenarios and their effect on demand and revenue.
kids.no_desc: Prissetting modellerer ulike prisingsscenarier for produkter og deres effekt på etterspørsel og inntekter.

kids.en_desc: Financial Planning & Analysis is the planning, budgeting, forecasting, modelling, and analysis of an institution's finances.
kids.notes: Financial Planning & Analysis supports an institution's financial health and business strategy. This includes operational and financial data analysis to measure business operations and forecast their financial impact to guide an institution's major business decisions.
kids.no_desc: Budsjett og analyse innebærer planlegging, budsjettering, prognoser, modellering og analyse av en institusjons økonomi.

kids.en_desc: Tax Management administers the calculation, declaration, and fulfilment of an institution's tax obligations.
kids.notes: Tax Management includes tax processing and the administration of current and future tax liabilities.
kids.no_desc: Skatter og avgifter administrerer en institusjons skatteforhold.

kids.en_desc: Bank Management oversees and manages banking transactions of an institution.
kids.no_desc: Bank overvåker og administrerer banktransaksjoner for en institusjon.

kids.en_desc: Procurement identifies and sources goods and services an institution acquires.
kids.notes: Procurement includes the establishment of procurement strategy, category management, selection of preferred vendors, acquisition of goods and services, and supplier performance management. It takes into account all strategic objectives including financial, social, sustainability, and indigenous outcomes.
kids.no_desc: Innkjøp identifiserer og skaffer varer og tjenester som en institusjon trenger.

kids.en_desc: Project Accounting records and monitors the financial status of projects.
kids.no_desc: Prosjektøkonomi registrerer og overvåker den økonomiske statusen til prosjekter.

kids.en_desc: Asset Management undertakes the lifecycle management of physical assets.
kids.notes: For context, BC197 was briefly known as "Fixed Asset Accounting" --- "managing and accounting for fixed asset transactions including additions, retires, transfers, adjustments, and depreciation expense", at which time its capability notes read: "This includes recording entries to the fixed asset register and tracking fixed assets through physical inventories. This process often supports tax, statutory and regulatory reporting by providing data on fixed assets to the appropriate department. Note, these come from APQC and do not overlap with other items we have, and also are complementary to Project Accounting."
kids.no_desc: Eiendeler gjennomfører livssyklusforvaltning av fysiske eiendeler.

kids.en_desc: Investment Management manages an institution's portfolio of securities.
kids.notes: Investment Management is concerned with a portfolio of securities that includes such things as bonds, shares, and real-estate investments.
kids.no_desc: Investering administrerer en institusjons portefølje av verdipapirer.

kids.en_desc: Payroll Management administers employee compensation through calculation, disbursement, and compliance with regulatory and institutional requirements.
kids.notes: The end-to-end scope of Payroll Management includes salary calculation, payment, taxation, time and attendance integration, and regulatory reporting.
kids.no_desc: Lønn beregner og utbetaler lønnsutbetalinger.

kids.en_desc: Treasury Management oversees institutional holdings, with the ultimate goal of managing liquidity and mitigating operational, financial, and reputational risk.
kids.notes: Treasury Management ensures that operating cash flows are maintained to meet immediate obligations and that any associated financial, operational, and reputational risks are managed.
kids.no_desc: Kasse overvåker institusjonens beholdninger med mål om å forvalte likviditet og redusere operasjonell, finansiell og omdømmemessig risiko.

kids.en_desc: General Accounting manages the chart of accounts and general ledger for an institution.
kids.notes: General Accounting generally follows the principles and expectations of guidelines such as GAAP (Generally-Acceptable Accounting Principles) and IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards).
kids.no_desc: Generell regnskapsføring administrerer kontoplanen og hovedboken for en institusjon.

caps.en_desc: Information & Communication Technology Management plans, builds, and runs an institution's technology services and solutions.
caps.notes: The four business capabilities that are children BC201, Information & Communication Technology Management, were seeded to reflect the four primary process domains from the COBIT framework. We acknowledge COBIT as the inspiration for these four capabilities, and encourage users of the model to undertake further examination of the COBIT framework by visiting the ISACA website.
caps.no_desc: IT, utvikler og drifter en institusjons teknologitjenester og løsninger.

kids.en_desc: Alignment, Planning, & Organisation manages and maintains alignment between information and technology services, business priorities, and institution goals.
kids.no_desc: Samsvar, planlegging og organisering sikrer og opprettholder samsvar mellom informasjon- og teknologitjenester, forretningsprioriteringer og institusjonens mål.

kids.en_desc: Build, Acquisition, & Implementation provides the basis for introducing and integrating new or changed technology solutions and services.
kids.notes: These technology solutions and services may contribute to the realisation of any business capability the institution requires across the Enabling, Learning & Teaching, and Research value chains.
kids.no_desc: Utvikle, anskaffe og implementere gir grunnlag for innføring og integrering av nye eller endrede teknologiløsninger og tjenester.

kids.en_desc: Delivery, Service, & Support provides and supports an institution with the information and communication technology services it requires.
kids.no_desc: Leveranser, vedlikehold og støtte leverer og støtter en institusjon med de informasjon- og kommunikasjonsteknologitjenestene den trenger.

kids.en_desc: Monitoring, Assessment, & Evaluation provides quantitative analysis of the performance of technology services.
kids.no_desc: Overvåke, vurdere og evaluere gir kvantitativ analyse av ytelsen til teknologitjenester.

caps.en_desc: Business Capability Management designs, configures, and lifecycle-manages an institution's business capabilities.
caps.notes: This capability provides guidance and direction on how business capabilities are fulfilled. The outcomes sought from Business Capability Management vary from one enterprise to another, but are concerned typically with efficiency and effectiveness, user experience, and ensuring that the formation and operation of business capabilities is sustainable and enduring.
caps.no_desc: Forvaltning av virksomhetskapabiliteter utformer, konfigurerer og administrerer livssyklusen til institusjonens forretningskapabiliteter.

kids.en_desc: Change Management manages the effects of change on people.
kids.notes: Change management incorporates the institution's tools and techniques, such as Prosci's ADKAR, to design change experiences for employees, students, and all customers and stakeholders of an institution.
kids.no_desc: Endringsledelse håndterer effektene av endringer på mennesker.

kids.en_desc: Benefits Management identifies, measures, and evaluates the anticipated benefits associated with a given change initiative.
kids.no_desc: Nyttestyring identifiserer, måler og evaluerer de forventede fordelene (nyttevirkninger) knyttet til et gitt endringsinitiativ.

kids.en_desc: Enterprise Architecture is concerned with the holistic identification and analysis of change execution throughout the entire enterprise operating model.
kids.no_desc: Virksomhetsarkitektur utfører analyse, design, planlegging og implementering på virksomhetsnivå for å støtte vellykket utvikling og realisering av strategi.

kids.en_desc: Portfolio & Programme Management selects, prioritises, and controls groups of initiatives executed as projects, product increments, or business-as-usual activities.
kids.no_desc: Portefølje- og programforvaltning velger, prioriterer og styrer grupper av initiativer som utføres som prosjekter, produktinkrementer eller løpende aktiviteter.

kids.en_desc: Business Process Management discovers, models, and analyses an institution's business processes.
kids.no_desc: Forvalte virksomhetsprosesser oppdager, modellerer og analyserer en institusjons virksomhetsprosesser.

kids.en_desc: Customer Experience Management is the practice of designing, tracking, and reacting to interactions between customers and an institution.
kids.notes: Customer Experience Management is usually undertaken with the goal of meeting or exceeding customer satisfaction and customer expectations throughout the customer lifecycle.
kids.no_desc: Forvalte brukererfaringer er praksisen med å utforme, overvåke og reagere på interaksjoner mellom brukere og en institusjon.

kids.en_desc: Service Management is a business capability that designs all aspects of services and service and support models.
kids.notes: Service Management typically has a goal of ensuring that services are fit for purpose, fit for use, sustainable, resilient, and robust. This capability includes defining service catalogues, service agreements, service availability, service capacity, and (subject to the institution's [Business Continuity Management] decisions) service continuity plans and designs.
kids.no_desc: Tjenesteforvaltning er en virksomhetskapabilitet som utformer alle aspekter av tjenester samt tjeneste- og brukerstøttemodeller.

kids.en_desc: Business Planning creates specific, measurable, and actionable activities that execute strategy.
kids.notes: Note that these business plans are often seen as operational plans.
kids.no_desc: Virksomhetssplanlegging skaper spesifikke, målbare og handlingsrettede aktiviteter som realiserer strategi.

kids.en_desc: Project Management structures work packages and manages resources to meet scope, time, and quality requirements.
kids.no_desc: Prosjektledelse strukturerer arbeidspakker og administrerer ressurser for å oppfylle krav til omfang, tid og kvalitet.

kids.en_desc: Product Management identifies, prioritises, and manages feature and function increments for an institution's products.
kids.no_desc: Produktforvaltning identifiserer, prioriterer og administrerer forbedring av egenskaper og funksjoner for institusjonens produkter.

caps.en_desc: Advancement Management develops investment and philanthropy in support of the institution's mission.
caps.notes: Advancement Management mobilises relationships and resources that align institutional priorities with the common good, securing financial, in-kind, and intellectual support.
caps.no_desc: Fremme virksomheten bygger forståelse og støtte for en institusjons visjon, misjon, langsiktige investeringer, engasjement, deltakelse og filantropi.

kids.en_desc: Alumni Management enables and delivers ongoing services, continuing engagement, and relationship management to alumni.
kids.no_desc: Alumni muliggjør og leverer tjenester, kontinuerlig engasjement og relasjonsstyring til alumni.

kids.en_desc: Fundraising solicits and secures gifts to the institution.
kids.notes: Fundraising focuses on solicitation, gift processing, pledge management, and associated compliance and reporting. Operates in close partnership with development activity (prospect identification, cultivation, stewardship). Covers all giving channels (major gifts, annual giving, bequests, corporate sponsorships, crowdfunding, etc.) and both monetary and non-monetary contributions.
kids.no_desc: Arbeider for å innhente og sikre gaver og donasjoner til institusjonen.

caps.en_desc: Engagement & Relationship Management develops and sustains connections between an institution and its constituent individuals, stakeholders, and groups.
caps.notes: Engagement & Relationship Management is the overarching business capability that includes communications, engagement, relationships, and outreach with all of an institution's constituent individuals, stakeholders, and groups (i.e., staff and students, industry and government, communities and groups, and donors, sponsors, and philanthropists).
caps.no_desc: Engasjement og nettverk utvikler og opprettholder forbindelser mellom en institusjon og dens kunder, interessenter og grupper.

kids.en_desc: Communications Management delivers and responds to broadcast and conversational communications.
kids.notes: Communications Management is a comprehensive business capability that includes communications between the institution and its internal and external audiences. The scope of communications includes contexts such as marketing and publicity, crisis and emergency, staff and student engagement, and other purposes.
kids.no_desc: Kommunikasjon leverer og reagerer på kringkastet og dialogbasert kommunikasjon.

kids.en_desc: Relationship Management develops and sustains relationships between an institution and its customers, stakeholders, and groups.
kids.notes: The scope of Relationship Management covers all the B2X flavours (B2E, B2C, B2B, etc) and covers all of customer and supplier, partner and alliance, and donor, sponsor, and philanthropist relationship management and so forth. For Relationship Management encompasses all non-transactional stakeholder-engagement activity, including development work that cultivates and stewards prospective donors before any fundraising solicitation occurs.
kids.no_desc: Nettverk utvikler og opprettholder relasjoner mellom en institusjon og dens kunder, interessenter og grupper.

kids.en_desc: Outreach Management broadcasts targeted information and invitations to engage into relevant groups.
kids.no_desc: Samfunnskontakt sprer målrettet informasjon og invitasjoner for å engasjere relevante grupper.

kids.en_desc: Engagement Management facilitates dialogue with specific groups to understand their needs and enable collaborative decisions.
kids.no_desc: Dialog legger til rette for dialog med spesifikke grupper for å forstå deres behov og muliggjøre samarbeidende beslutninger.

kids.en_desc: Extension Management facilitates the delivery of educational opportunities and resources that extend the institution's knowledge and expertise to the wider community.
kids.notes: Extension, particularly for the Land Grant Universities in the United States of America, is an important undertaking often undertaken by a distinct business unit of the institution.
kids.no_desc: Kunnskapsformidling muliggjør overføring av kunnskap og forskningsresultater fra en institusjon for anvendelse av utvalgte grupper.
